notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes: version 1.04 final update for DLC Release. Removed extra pyramid definition.

notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.notes: Version 1.03: Reduces the file size for the six included decks and prepares everything for the release of our first DLC, Solitaire Favorites!

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.notes: [b]Version 1.02[/b] includes the addition of an undo button for devices using a touchscreen without acces to a keyboard. It also corrects an error in the website redirect to correctly go to WyvernSolitaire.com. Additionally cleaned up some menu behavior to remove the menu tab from screens where it doesn't need to be visible.
